findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insufficient key size validation
 * @description RSA key generation or usage without proper key size validation
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/insufficient-key-size
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-326
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("rsa").getMember(["newkeys", "generate", "PrivateKey", "PublicKey"]).getACall()
select call, "RSA key operation - check for key size validation"
findings.hypothesis: RSA key generation or usage without proper key size validation

message.text: RSA key operation - check for key size validation
